entries.note: Long arched polytunnel: frosted film on steel hoops over two green crop beds and a walkway, a door at each short end. A covered farm on a world that cannot grow food in the open; walk-in, no cover.
The polytunnel half as long, for the end of a row.
Sealed geodesic grow dome over a round hydroponic bed, airlock porch south. Walk-in, no cover.
Water and nutrient tanks with a pump on a low skid, beside a covered farm.

note: A colony's covered farm (story-map-pools.md, Planet skin): what stands on a worked field on a world that cannot grow food in the open, in rows on the cleared plot, passable and coverless so the map's layout never moves. Measured 1448x1086 RGBA, four alpha pieces. Geometry-first reskin of templates/greenhouses-guide.png (greenhouses-guide.py, 180 px a cell); ImageGen returned the sheet uniformly at 0.943 of the guide and every piece within a few pixels of its guide, so each rect is its guide frame at that scale. Exact prompt in greenhouses.prompt.txt.
